lines.trans: Whisky, please. Thank you.
Miss, bring me a cappuccino without cinnamon.
All right, I'll bring it right now.
Or rather, make it with cinnamon!
Many of you have begun to have doubts. I want to tell you.
The process is moving along, everything is fine. The cluster will be built!
I still expect participation from you. That is all.
Pasha, tell us instead. Is the governor with us?

words.gram: masculine given name, vocative (diminutive of Pavel)

lines.trans: Of course he is with us!
But I know that he put the question off. He is waiting for the election results.
That's funny! What election results could there possibly be?
I don't know. Maybe Samsonov will win.
Stay calm! The chairwoman of the election commission is sitting right here with us. Right now we will find out everything from her.
Here is your cappuccino.
My dear, I asked for it with cinnamon!

examples.trans: He ordered a glass of whisky with ice.

впрочем.gloss: or rather, however, on second thought

meanings.en: or rather, on second thought, however

examples.trans: Or rather, make it with cinnamon!

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: He is running in the election.
The governor has come to the town.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Здесь у нас сидит председатель избиркома.
examples.trans: The chairwoman of the election commission is sitting right here with us.
The election commission announced the election results.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: Miss, bring me a cappuccino without cinnamon.

meanings.en: cluster (a big industrial or business project)
meanings.note: in the show: the Moscow investors' project

examples.trans: There will be a cluster in the town.
The mayor is against the cluster.

meanings.note: с корицей = with cinnamon; без корицы = without cinnamon

examples.text: Милая, я же просил с корицей!
examples.trans: My dear, I asked for it with cinnamon!

многие из вас = many of you

отложить.gloss: to put aside, to put down; to postpone

examples.trans: We postponed the meeting until tomorrow.

meanings.en: still, as before, just as previously

examples.trans: They still live in this building.

meanings.en: to defeat, to beat, to win

examples.trans: They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up

examples.text: Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!
examples.trans: Let him just show up here one more time!

meanings.note: head of a court, committee, or board

examples.trans: I am the chairman of the court.
What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Я жду только одного — результатов от вас.
examples.trans: I expect only one thing: results from you.
